t: You're at the monument to Henry Richard in Abney Park Cemetery, in Hackney. Henry Richard, who lived from 1812 to 1888, was a Congregational minister and a Welsh Member of Parliament from 1868 until his death. He's remembered above all as an advocate of peace and international arbitration, and for forty years, from 1848 to 1884, he was secretary of the Peace Society. He also worked in the anti-slavery cause.
